village.setting: You and your companions have arrived at Nyshalanor, the famed village of silver-leaved trees and moonlit lakes. Upon arrival, your main priority is to gain information on how to enter the dungeon. Do you (1) Wander and explore the mystical streets of Nyshalanor or (2) Converse with the villagers on the streets?

explore.setting: As you wander through the paths of Nyshalanor, admiring the graceful architecture and whispering willows, you eventually come upon a carved silverwood sign outside a grand vine-covered hall that reads, “More Information on the Newly Discovered Dungeon.” You have stumbled across the Guild Hall of Nyshalanor. After signing up as a beginner adventurer, you are tasked to gain your dungeon license by completing a quest. You must fight a baby Huskryn that had escaped when the dungeon was first discovered. This is your chance to prove your strength! Do you (1) Accept the quest and fight the Huskyrn or (2) Cower at the thought and change your mind?

converse.setting: You speak to the first elven villager you encounter. Luckily, this villager seems to know their stuff, as they direct you to the Guild Hall to sign up as an adventurer. Once you have sign up successfully, the guildmaster explains that in order to enter the dungeon, you must prove your worth and gain your dungeon license by completing a quest: defeating a baby Huskryn. Do you (1) Accept the quest to fight the Huskryn or (2) Decline and retreat back home?

accept.setting: You accept the task to face the baby Huskyn, your mind already drifting to the treasures rumored to lie deep within the dungeon, fueling your resolve as you begin to prepare for the battle ahead. You make your way to the overgrown glade where the baby Huskryn was last spotted, the air thick with tension and the scent of damp earth—then, as the brush rustles ahead, you ready your weapon, knowing the time has come to fight!

decline.setting: You shrink back at the thought of facing the baby Huskryn, fear tightening your chest as you realize you're not willing to risk your life for treasure or glory—so you turn away from the adventurer’s path and quietly begin the long journey back home.

win.setting: After a grueling and bloody battle, you finally slay the baby Huskryn, returning to the Guild Hall weary but victorious to claim your hard-earned dungeon license. Later, you approach the dungeon’s looming entrance, presenting your license to the stoic guard, who nods silently and steps aside. As the heavy shadows within the stone archway stretch before you, a chill runs down your spine—you’re beginning to grasp the true dangers that await beyond. Do you (1) Push through and enter the dungeon or (2) Cower in fear and leave?

enter.setting: You take a steadying breath, pushing aside the fear gnawing at your thoughts, and step forward into the darkness—each footfall echoing with the weight of your decision as the dungeon swallows you whole.

leave.setting: Your resolve crumbles beneath the weight of dread; unwilling to gamble your life against the unknown, you turn from the dungeon’s entrance and begin the long, quiet journey back home.
